items.title: Apnimed scouts $160m IPO to back late-stage sleep apnoea pill development
items.summary: Apnimed will use the IPO funds to progress lead candidate oxnimbi, which could become the first pill to break onto the OSA market.

items.title: BioMarin and n-Lorem partner on early research for ReNU syndrome therapy
items.summary: BioMarin Pharmaceutical and n-Lorem Foundation have entered a collaboration and licence agreement to develop an investigational ASO therapy for ReNU syndrome.

items.title: Argenx signs agreement to buy Forte Biosciences for $2.2bn
items.summary: argenx has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Forte Biosciences for approximately $2.2bn in total equity value.

items.title: Why the India-UK trade deal now needs a five-gate implementation ledger
items.summary: Varun Sharma, founder and CEO of NEUVIOR, reflects on the necessitates of the recently forged India-UK pharma trade deal.
